summary: T55 DevTools Protocol did not respond to repeated labeled-switch clicks and remained on through reload; dependent CDP tools were not invoked. T59 Tab video capture completed the Chrome deny/allow flow, returned to off, and remained off after reload.

cases.EXT-F-1003-T55: Fail: initial state was on; two accessibility-targeted clicks and one visible switch click left it on with no Chrome prompt. It remained on after reload. Off/on, denial, and CDP tool availability remain unverified.
cases.EXT-F-1003-T59: Pass: Chrome denial left the switch off; accepting on retry turned it on; toggling off and reloading preserved off. No recording was started.

defects: DevTools Protocol switch did not leave its on state after repeated UI clicks; recorded as observed without inferring a cause.
limitations: Transient busy state was not observed in immediate post-click accessibility snapshots.
No debugger session or CDP tool was invoked; no video was recorded.
cleanup: DevTools Protocol on and Tab video capture off, both matching initial states. Settings remains open at Advanced agent capabilities after extension reload; UI stopped.
